status: PROPOSED synthetic and physical QA; NOT EXECUTED

items.query: WASAPI DATA_DISCONTINUITY SILENT TIMESTAMP_ERROR combinations and BUFFER_EMPTY
acceptance: Each flag retains its own meaning; SILENT alone does not imply glitch
TIMESTAMP_ERROR never establishes timing PASS; empty packet does not reuse stale timestamps

items.query: Duplex capture and render endpoints have independent clock frequencies and QPC samples
acceptance: Normalize IAudioClock position using GetFrequency and QPC to 100 ns
No raw position comparison across endpoints; shared-only IAudioClock2 respected

items.query: Late packet after Stop Reset or endpoint invalidation races with new capture generation
acceptance: Old generation packet cannot update current measurement
Reset begins new epoch; Stop/Start without Reset does not imply position zero

items.query: Synthetic tests pass but no physical USB capture evidence exists
acceptance: Report DOC_REVIEW/SYNTHETIC separately from hardware PASS
Physical claim requires device identity, mode, actual period, duration, sample format, artifacts and hashes

items.query: GetBuffer pointer lease, ReleaseBuffer(0) replay, invalid partial count, delayed processing and cancellation
acceptance: Consume full packet or none; ReleaseBuffer(frame_count) for full read, zero only for none; partial count rejected
No pointer use after release; no unbounded wait on UI/network/disk; record lease budget and HRESULT
Injected invalidation and cancellation preserve cleanup and do not count stale packets as stable

items.query: Shared GetNextPacketSize versus exclusive event/polling capture packet-size contract
acceptance: GetNextPacketSize only shared and same capture thread; shared size matches subsequent GetBuffer
Exclusive polling padding is only a snapshot; actual GetBuffer frames may be larger
Exclusive event path does not assume polling padding equality

items.query: Physical USB device period and lease latency evidence for minimum stable buffer qualification
acceptance: Record device ID, mode, requested and effective period, sample format, duration, loss/discontinuity flags, lease p95/p99/max and artifact hashes
Evaluate candidate supported buffers by transport stability and bounded processing, not signal amplitude or fixed 3/10 ms
DOC_REVIEW and synthetic test success never become hardware PASS

items.query: Stop/Reset races with a held GetBuffer packet
acceptance: No Reset while active lease; expected BUFFER_OPERATION_PENDING classified
Cancellation joins worker within declared timeout; no stale packet accepted
Stop alone preserves clock position; Reset on stopped stream starts new epoch

items.query: Injected DEVICE_INVALIDATED RESOURCES_INVALIDATED SERVICE_NOT_RUNNING and BUFFER_ERROR
acceptance: Each HRESULT retained and classified; no invalidated scan counts as stable
Transient exclusive BUFFER_ERROR waits without spin; repeated errors enter bounded recovery
Reopened client uses fresh generation and capability discovery

items.query: Repeated Stop and cancellation while event wait is blocked
acceptance: Wake and bounded join complete; no COM release while worker uses client
Repeated Stop is idempotent; late callback cannot publish into new epoch
Physical USB unplug and long-duration test remain NOT EXECUTED
